note: Every dimension the encoder and the simulation use lives here. Units are micrometres unless a key says nm. All values are lengths or refractive indices; no value is fitted to a result.

waveguide.kappa_note: 0.1477 measured at width 0.30 and gap 0.20; it gives a half-beat length of 10.6 um, while the length actually used is 8.0

pixel.transition_note: the bend into and out of the gap follows a raised-cosine ramp; a straight ramp gives a slope jump at both ends
pixel.reference_note: the run taken as the reference uses an active length of 8.66 um, 8.3 % longer than the value above, and reads every pixel correctly

readout.note: a pixel is the mean of |E|^2 over +-8 um along the pixel and +-0.10 um across the straight waveguide, in units of the input power; 0.367 is midway between the dimmest bright pixel (0.568) and the brightest dark pixel (0.166)

image.format: one line per row, '#' for a bright pixel, '.' for a dark one
